summary: Iteration 17 — Focused re-validation of the 3 fixes from iter16. ALL 3 fixes verified: (1) CRITICAL migrate-structure lock now correctly uses q.get('quote_status'); a quote transitioned to 'sent' returns ok:false, reason:'quote_locked' (was ok:true previously). (2) Migration is idempotent: 2nd call on a clean quote returns ok:true, no_changes:true via early-return (counters all zero, tree unchanged). (3) tree.migration_required is now True whenever orphan_openings exist, even without any environments (was requiring both). Regression: full iter16 suite re-run = 21/21 pass. New focused suite = 5/5 pass. Grand total: 26/26.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: quote_structure.py::migrate_quote guard at line 387 correctly uses q.get('quote_status') and covers the full immutable set ('sent','accepted','signed','converted').
GOOD: idempotency early-return at line ~397 correctly checks both orphan_openings==[] AND all lines have role+opening_id, preventing spurious version bumps.
GOOD: tree endpoint migration_required = len(orphan_openings) > 0 — clean semantics, UI can now surface migration CTA on fully-legacy quotes with zero envs.

NOTE (not a bug): the idempotency early-return does NOT re-check whether any line is missing a role/opening_id — the guard `all(l.get('role') and l.get('opening_id') for l in lines)` handles that, so mixed states still fall through to the full migration path. Verified via test_migrate_twice_returns_no_changes_on_second_call.
